messages:
alex: Quick thread — planning to publish py/ts SDK patch v1.12.3 in tonight's quiet window (23:00 UTC). Will run deploy-bot canary first and then flip dist-tags. Need a quick 👍 on the pin strategy and rollback steps.

sam: timeline ok for me. what's changing in this patch?

alex: tiny bugfix for tokenization edge-case + tighten retry backoff. Also we want to soft-deprecate the legacy sync client in the changelog and set a grace period notice. Not removing code in this release.

maggie: agree with soft-deprecate text. can we avoid auto-removal of any dist-tags that customers might rely on? request: keep old dist-tag "legacy" for two weeks.

alex: plan: publish canary -> smoke tests -> promote to stable tag. We'll pin "stable" to 1.12.3 for customers on reserved capacity who asked to pin. Keep "legacy" pointing to 1.11.9 for 2 weeks.

jen: who will publish? I can handle npm/pypi publish if ops approves.

alex: thanks — jen please do. i'll run the release notes and the deprecation blurb. sam can do post-publish smoke on dedicated.

jen: copying commands i'll use so ops can vet:
```
# python wheel build + upload
python -m build && twine upload dist/* --repository pypi
# npm publish and tag
npm publish --access public && npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.12.3 stable
# set legacy tag to keep older pin
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.11.9 legacy
```

ops-bot: @jen please ensure you have the ephemeral publish token set (SECRETS:SDK_PUBLISH_TOKEN). Missing token will abort.

jen: token present. will start canary in ~10m and post logs here.

deploy-bot: Started canary publish for @redwood/sdk v1.12.3 (canary cohort: 10% traffic). Monitor: /deploys/1718204321-canary

sam: i'll watch logs. if canary latency or error rate spikes >1% relative, we rollback. exact criteria: 95th p95 increase >30ms or error-rate delta >1%.

maggie: also watch embedding/streaming tests — regression there is showstopper.

deploy-bot: Canary completed: 10% cohort stable for 12m. Observed error-rate delta 0.2%, p95 delta +8ms. No user-facing regressions in canary.

alex: sounds good. Proceed to promote to stable and update dist-tags as planned. jen, please go ahead.

jen: promoting now. will post the exact commands output after done.

deploy-bot: Promotion started: moving canary -> stable, updating dist-tags.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. npm dist-tag: stable -> 1.12.3, legacy -> 1.11.9. PyPI: 1.12.3 uploaded.

jen: publish logs: successful. checksum: sha256:abcdef123456. posted changelog draft: https://docs.internal/release-notes/1.12.3 (w/ deprec blurb).

sam: doing post-publish smoke. running integration suites now.

ops-bot: Reminder: create a follow-up ticket to remind support to post notice in customer portal about legacy tag and deprecation timeline.

maggie: integration suites green. No regressions on streaming tests.

sam: looks good from dedicated run. No rollback needed. +1 from me.

alex: thanks everyone. final checklist for record: [x] canary ok [x] promote ok [x] changelog posted [x] legacy tag preserved 2w [x] support ticket created. I'll send the deprecation email in the morning.

jen: quick note on rollback commands (if needed):
- NPM: npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.12.2 stable
- PyPI: push a yanked release or notify clients to pin to 1.12.2
- In emergency, revert client SDK CDN assets and config in the console routing layer.

alex: saved. If anything crops up overnight ping #eng-oncall and flag with incidentbot.

deploy-bot: Incidentbot notified on manual trigger.

sam: thanks, team. closing thread. :tada:
